items.title: Volker Türk, the UN high commissioner for human rights, reports that M23 rebels have killed over 319 civilians in July. M23 president Bertrand Bisimwa said the group would investigate the claim.

United States: 11 – Wildfires caused by high winds from Hurricane Dora strike the island of Maui in Hawaii, almost completely destroying the town of Lahaina. As of August 25, 115 people have been killed, 67 have been injured, over 380 people are missing, and 2,207 buildings have been destroyed.
Iran reports a record of 39,619 new cases and 542 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4,158,729 and the nationwide death toll to 94,015.
Malaysia reports a record 360 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 10,749.
Hurricane Hilda (2015) peaked at Category 4, 125-knot winds and 937 hPa
127 people are killed and 2,000 missing in landslides in Gansu Province, China, due to ongoing flooding.
The death toll rises to 132 and injury toll is at least 400 as severe flash floods devastate Kashmir.
